We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. **The Team**
 Through continued growth comes more demand for business insights and data used to make objective decisions. To support this need and help maintain operational efficiency, A\&M has invested in growing its Business Intelligence Unit (BIU). The BIU creates and maintains scalable data pipelines, constructs analysis, delivers process improvement initiatives and builds visualization tools and applications. The unit is also focused on embedding AI into its own ways of working to drive efficiency, and on enabling the business to apply AI to the data assets the team provides. All with the goal of supporting the firm to realize operational efficiencies identified through analysis. The BIU operates across multiple geographies and practice areas, supporting decision\-making for senior stakeholders across the firm. The Insight Optimisation team is responsible for the ongoing health, evolution, and optimization of the firm's core reporting products. The team manages report consistency, user experience, backend data model improvements, documentation, troubleshooting, and enhancement requests. The team mission is to provide a seamless user experience to the business whilst reducing long\-term operational overhead through prioritising consistency, consolidation, and a focus on action\-driven insights.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 The Business Intelligence Unit is seeking a motivated Associate to join the Insight Optimisation team based in India. Reporting to the Manager of Insight Optimisation, the Associate will play a hands\-on role in maintaining and improving the firm's existing core reporting suite, supporting business users, and contributing to the transition to a new Snowflake data environment.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused role for someone with strong technical foundations in Power BI and SQL, a curiosity for how data is used across a business, and the discipline to work through complex troubleshooting scenarios. The successful candidate will spend their time building improvements to existing reports, investigating data issues, maintaining documentation, and working directly with business users to understand and deliver on their needs. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, comfortable working across the analytics stack, curious about how AI can enhance their work, and eager to develop their skills in a global, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

* Review report usage statistics and user feedback to identify opportunities to improve formatting, usability, and consistency across the reporting suite.
* Implement improvements to existing reports and dashboards, applying user\-centred design principles to enhance the end\-user experience.
* Review dashboard refresh times and backend data models, identifying and applying efficiency improvements in how data is brought into the reporting layer.
* Maintain user guides, definition lists, and technical documentation as new tabs and data sources are added over time.
* Triage and troubleshoot queries received through the BIU inbox, systematically diagnosing whether issues sit at the reporting layer, database level, or source level.
* Escalate complex or cross\-layer issues appropriately and work collaboratively with the wider team to resolve them.
* Support the transition of existing reports to the new Snowflake environment, repointing reports and testing to ensure continuity of service for business users.
* Apply AI and generative AI tools to accelerate day\-to\-day delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Communicate clearly with business users on the status of their requests, expected timelines, and any technical constraints.
* Contribute to team\-wide initiatives to improve ways of working, share knowledge, and raise the collective technical standard of the team
* Keep up to date with the latest tools and techniques in BI, analytics, and AI, and apply them where they can add value


**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a data\-focused role.
* Strong report development experience, preferably Power BI, including visualisation, data modelling, and DAX.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write, read, and optimise queries against relational databases.
* Understanding of data modelling concepts and how data flows through a modern analytics stack.
* Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms is desirable; willingness to learn is essential.
* Awareness of current AI and generative AI tools, with an interest in applying them to analytics workflows and reporting products.
* Structured troubleshooting approach, with the ability to isolate problems across the analytics stack.
* Exposure to user\-centred design principles and an appreciation for the end\-user experience of analytics products.
* Familiarity with Python or another scripting language is a plus.
* Experience working in a globally distributed team or across time zones is desirable.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a relevant field, or equivalent professional work experience

The organization supports individuals, startups, and enterprises through AI and research consulting, product development, technical research services, and collaborative projects. Its work spans Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, Multi\-Agent Systems, RAG/GraphRAG, Data Science, and Intelligent Systems. By guiding projects from problem exploration to experimentation, prototyping, and deployment, Insider AI helps bridge the gap between academic research and implementation. The initiative actively collaborates with researchers, students, academics, and organizations on innovative AI projects, publications, and research\-driven products.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Data Science Intern role at insider.aiiiiiii is a remote internship focused on supporting AI and data\-driven research and product development. On a day\-to\-day basis, the intern will collect, clean, and analyze datasets; perform exploratory data analysis; and assist in building statistical and machine learning models. The intern will contribute to experiment design, model evaluation, and result documentation for internal projects and client engagements. Responsibilities may also include preparing visualizations and reports, collaborating with AI researchers and engineers, and helping prototype data\-driven features for AI products. This internship is designed to provide hands\-on experience with real\-world AI and data science challenges in a research\-oriented environment.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and a solid understanding of Data Analysis.
* Candidates should possess foundational knowledge in Statistics and Data Science.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Analytics, including working with structured and unstructured datasets.
* Basic familiarity with programming languages used in data science (e.g., Python, R) and common data science libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn) is beneficial.
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to communicate findings clearly, work independently in a remote setting, and collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team is expected.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, and research\-oriented projects, with willingness to learn new tools and methodologies, is highly valued.
